name: 05 · Missed Call Alert — Exotel Webhook → WhatsApp Callback

nodes.name: Exotel Missed Call Webhook
nodes.notes: ⚙ CONFIGURE: In your Exotel Dashboard → Apps → Passthru App (or Flow), set the 'Status Callback URL' to https://<your-n8n-host>/webhook/exotel-missed-call. Exotel sends form-encoded POST data.

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, department FROM employees WHERE phone LIKE $1 OR phone LIKE $2 LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Lookup Caller in DB
nodes.notes: Checks if the caller is a known employee or customer. Unknown callers still get a WhatsApp message.

nodes.name: Notify Backend Service
nodes.notes: Optional: push the event to your Node.js backend so it can update CRM state, assign a follow-up task, etc.
